nodes.label: The Last Human-Written Paper: Agent-Native Research Artifacts
nodes.author: Jiachen Liu et al.

nodes.label: Agent-Native Research Artifact (ARA) Protocol
nodes.rationale: Replaces the linear PDF with a four-layer structured, machine-executable package (claims, code, exploration graph, evidence) because narrative compression discards exact configs, design rationale, and failed-attempt history that agents specifically need.

nodes.label: Live Research Manager
nodes.rationale: Silently captures researcher decisions and dead ends as a side effect of ordinary AI-assisted work, promoting tentative observations to formal entries only on a closure signal, to avoid replacing one documentation burden with another.

nodes.label: Three-Level ARA Seal Verification Protocol
nodes.rationale: Structural/Rigor/Execution-Reproducibility levels let automated checks handle mechanical review so human reviewers can focus on judgment; Level 3 isolates the verifying agent from ground-truth evidence to reduce fabrication.
